params.QUERY: SELECT TOP 2000 source_id, ra, dec, ref_epoch, pmra, pmra_error, pmdec, pmdec_error, parallax, parallax_error, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, ruwe, radial_velocity, radial_velocity_error, phot_variable_flag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 187.2779158, 2.0523889, 0.0313393)) AND (pm >= 100.0 OR DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), POINT('ICRS', 187.2779158, 2.0523889)) <= 0.0027747)
